purpose: Historical SOXL Buy Score validation. v2 is retained for comparison; v3 is the current regime-aware RSI/extension model.

methodology.warning: These backfilled values are retrospective reconstructions, not contemporaneously stored SOXL scores. Each version uses only observations preserved in NasDecode history plus SOXL bars available through that date.
methodology.technicalInputs: SOXL history is truncated at each T0 before 20DMA, 5D return, RSI14 and distance from 20-day closing high are computed.
methodology.forwardReturns: Close-to-close SOXL return from T0 close to the nth subsequent trading-session close.
methodology.v3Change: Top-level weights unchanged. v3 replaces hard 20DMA/RSI chase caps with nonlinear RSI Entry Quality, continuous regime-aware 20DMA extension penalty, and continuous RSI x 20DMA overheating penalty.
methodology.semiconductorTrendV2: 30% SOXX technical trend + 25% SOX relative strength + 15% SOXX relative strength + 10% SMH relative strength + 20% semiconductor breadth. SOXX technical trend = 40% 20DMA trend + 30% 5D momentum + 30% RSI14 trend.
methodology.adxAtrV32: SOXX Technical Trend adds 20% directional ADX/DMI and reweights 20DMA/5D/RSI to 30/25/25. Volatility/Leverage Risk becomes 35% consolidation safety, 25% VXN condition, 15% VXN change, 25% SOXL ATR regime. ATR regime uses Wilder ATR14% 60-session percentile and ATR14/ATR50 expansion.
methodology.rsiV33: Corrects RSI14 methodology. Live scores use Massive native daily RSI API; historical reconstruction uses standard Wilder RSI from Massive adjusted daily OHLC. Previous simple 14-change RSI was invalid for NasDecode daily RSI.
